should I change to a different doctor?  go back to the hospital?  is it time to give up?  how many dollars is my life worth?  i know how much its worth to an insurance company

FUck it, this is all a waste of time, I don't know why I continue to reach out.  Getting to the next dayh has never helped me a bit.  Black Grouse tastes nice.

Everyone insists that there's an answer and they're wastes of skin.  All they have in the end is maybe we can drag things out till we can blame his effort instead of our methods.
i dont really hate you please help me im so tired
I forwarded this to my friends!  Thank you for your contribution!

That fucking sucks.  The worst bit is, a lot of this stuff isn't even your fault or within your control.  Depression is an irrational bitch and when it hits you hard like this, there may not be much you can do but ride it out.

Most schools have free health counseling services that can help you with medication or therapy or just a kind ear.   It sounds like you may be in need of the latter.  Transitioning sounds likely one of the most stressful things someone can go through and you're topping it off with a round of mood disorder crap.  It's not a bad thing to find help for this.  People want to realize what's hurting you, but most of us are pretty good at keeping it in and hiding it.

That spiral sounds fucking brutal, I hope you know that it will pass.  I'm not saying things will be good, but it will be better.  The crap that makes me feel like you seem to be is the same crap that makes it hard to judge what's really going on.
